description: Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome, Purleigh, Essex. Civil registration G-ABAA. Noted August 2025; this airframe is more usually credited to the Science and Industry Museum in Manchester, so its presence here should be re-confirmed.
Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome, Purleigh, Essex. Civilianised Auster, registered G-ARUI. Noted August 2025.
Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome, Purleigh, Essex. Nose section only of an air cadet training glider. Noted August 2025.
Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome, Purleigh, Essex. Full-size replica built from the original technical drawings using period materials; not an original airframe and carries no airframe serial.
Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome, Purleigh, Essex. Seven-eighths scale flying replica; not an original airframe and carries no airframe serial. Distinguished from the museum's B.E.2e replica by type.
